offering_description.value: Provides leadership, productivity and execution training and consulting built on the 7 Habits and 4 Disciplines of Execution, along with planners, books and digital subscription content. Sells mainly to businesses, government agencies, schools and individuals, delivered through on-site and virtual workshops, coaching and online platforms.

primary_products.value: planners and organizers; books; training workbooks; digital learning content

primary_services.value: leadership training; productivity and execution consulting; coaching; implementation services

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporations, professional firms, nonprofits, healthcare organizations; B2G: government agencies, public school districts; B2C: individual consumers buying planners and books

end_markets.value: corporate training; government; education; nonprofits; healthcare

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for training, consulting and coaching engagements; subscription: annual access to online training content and tools; product sales: planners, books and workbooks

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs its own leadership content and planners, sold to businesses, governments and individuals; service provider: delivers training and consulting to organizations and their employees; software / platform: online learning and productivity platform sold by subscription to organizations
value_chain_position.category: brand owner; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America plus clients and partners across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: leadership and productivity training, consulting, subscriptions, and planners and books

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling training and subscriptions to organizations; online: online store and digital platform for individuals and organizations; partners / resellers: international licensed partners and affiliates delivering its programs

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules, data privacy rules for online platform and customer data
